Job Description:

'We are seeking a highly skilled AI Automation Test Engineer with extensive hands-on experience in Playwright and a strong passion for building AI-powered test automation solutions to join our Quality Engineering team. This role focuses on designing scalable automation frameworks, leveraging AI to accelerate test creation and maintenance, and improving software quality through intelligent automation.

The ideal candidate will have expertise in modern automation frameworks, AI-assisted testing tools, CI/CD integration, and building reusable automation assets that improve engineering productivity and reduce maintenance effort.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable end-to-end automation frameworks using Playwright.
  • Design AI-assisted automation solutions that automatically generate, optimize, and maintain test cases.
  • Leverage Generative AI and LLM-based tools to accelerate test script development, defect analysis, and test data generation.
  • Implement self-healing automation capabilities to reduce flaky tests and maintenance effort.
  • Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, and page object models to improve test maintainability.
  • Create, execute, and maintain automated test scripts for functional, regression, smoke, and integration testing.
  • Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing.
  • Analyze test execution results, troubleshoot failures, and provide detailed reporting and root cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and product teams to ensure high software quality.
  • Optimize test execution for reliability, performance, and faster feedback cycles.
  • Evaluate emerging AI testing technologies and recommend improvements to the Quality Engineering practice.
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain high coding standards for automation scripts.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Expert-level experience with Playwright for end-to-end web automation.
  • Strong programming skills in Java Script or Type Script (Type Script preferred).
  • Experience using Git Hub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor AI, or similar AI coding assistants for automation development.
  • Experience building AI-assisted automation frameworks using LLMs.
  • Knowledge of prompt engineering for test generation and automation productivity.
  • Experience designing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks from scratch.
  • Hands-on experience in creating reusable automation components and utilities.
  • Experience integrating automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Technical Skills

  • Playwright
  • Java Script / Type Script (Preferred)
  • Jenkins
  • Prompt Engineering
  • AI-assisted Test Generation
  • Self-Healing Test Automation
  • AI-based Test Data Generation
  • Git Hub Actions (or equivalent)
  • Git
  • Git Hub / Git Lab / Bitbucket
  • Playwright HTML Reports

Desired Skills:

  • Experience with AI testing platforms.
  • Experience with API automation using Playwright or REST API testing tools.
  • Knowledge of modern web technologies (HTML, CSS, Java Script, DOM).
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Familiarity with containerized test execution using Docker.
  • Exposure to cloud-based test execution platforms.
  • Experience with test data management and parallel test execution.
  • Understanding of software quality engineering best practices

EDUCATION:

  • BE/ BTech / BSC / MCA

Job Summary: We are looking for a skilled Confluent Kafka Support Engineer responsible for providing technical support, troubleshooting, and expert guidance for customers using Apache Kafka and the Confluent Platform. 1. Customer Support & Issue Resolution

  • Provide L2/L3 technical support for Kafka-based systems.

  • Handle incidents and ensure SLA adherence.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, IAM, Cloud Watch, S3, Lambda, VPC, Load balancers).
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.

  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.

  • CICD (AWS Code Pipeline, Harness)

Job Summary / Roles & Responsibilities

  • Deploy, configure, and maintain middleware components (application servers, web servers, message brokers, integration platforms, caching layers, etc.) on Linux environments.
  • Design and operate middleware solutions on AWS using native services and best practices, including EC2, EBS, ELB/ALB, Auto Scaling, VPC, IAM, AWS Systems Manager, Cloud Watch, Cloud Formation, AWS Certificate Manager, etc.
  • Install, patch, and harden middleware software following security and configuration standards.
  • Build and maintain automation for software deployment using Ansible, Python, shell scripts, etc.
  • Monitor middleware health, capacity, and performance; tune middleware and OS parameters to meet SLAs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the middleware stack; perform root cause analysis and drive permanent fixes.
  • Manage lifecycle activities, including upgrades, patching, platform migrations, and decommissioning.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines by integrating middleware deployments, managing artifacts, and validating releases.
  • Create and maintain runbooks, runtime documentation, and standard operating procedures.
  • Collaborate with application teams to onboard applications, define requirements, and optimize middleware configurations.

  • Strong Linux administration skills (Solaris, Oracle Linux, Ubuntu), including installation, filesystem management, networking, process management, kernel tuning, and SELinux basics.

  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or Perl for automation and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools and pipelines (Jenkins, Git Hub, Azure Dev Ops, etc.) and integrating middleware deployments into pipelines.
  • Familiarity with high availability, clustering, load balancing, and failover techniques for middleware.
  • Strong problem-solving, incident management, and communication skills with the ability to interact with developers and architects.

Education & Certifications

  • BE / BTech / MCA

Job Description:

We are seeking a senior Business Technology Partner (BTP). This role is based in Gurugram with a hybrid working model requiring at least three days per week in the office.

The BTP is the single accountable owner for end-to-end technology delivery within a defined business domain. This role drives execution and delivery outcomes by owning scope, schedule, quality, and business impact. The individual will actively engage with engineering and architecture teams to validate and challenge technical designs, identify and diagnose delivery risks early, and take decisive corrective actions to keep initiatives on track. The BTP is empowered to make binding trade-off decisions on scope, timeline, and quality within agreed guardrails and to directly intervene to remove blockers and drive resolution.

This role is for someone who can:

  • Demonstrate strong technical credibility with deep expertise in AI/ML and data platforms.
  • Operate effectively within a diversified, metric-driven global-local delivery model.
  • Collaborate with and influence senior stakeholders through clear decision-making and communication.
  • Think strategically while applying high emotional intelligence.
  • Exhibit adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced, complex technology environment

We will count on you to be accountable for:

Own delivery outcomes for all initiatives in the domain; be directly accountable for on-time, on-scope, on-quality delivery.

1.End-to-end technical delivery ownership

  • Make binding trade-off decisions on scope, timeline and quality for assigned initiatives within agreed guardrails; document and communicate decisions and impacts.
  • Diagnose root causes of delivery slippage and lead hands-on remediation plans; escalate only when guardrails are breached.
  • Enforce delivery commitments: allocate resources, re-plan, de-scope or extend timelines as needed to protect critical outcomes.
  • Hold engineering and vendor teams accountable for commitments; validate progress through direct evidence (demos, code reviews, deployment artifacts)

2.Delivery operational control

  • Establish and run delivery governance that drives decisions and action (execution reviews, checkpoints, RAID with owners and deadlines).
  • When delivery is slipping, step in immediately: diagnose root cause across technical, requirement and dependency dimensions and execute a remediation plan with named owners and timelines.
  • Act as the primary driver of resolution; coordinate, assign, and execute fixes across teams and vendors; escalate only after direct remediation attempts or when guardrails are exceeded.
  • Create constructive pressure to enforce scope, timeline and quality commitments; authorize exceptions or temporary workarounds where appropriate and timebound.

3.Engineering & architecture

  • Act as the technical authority for delivery constraints: interrogate, challenge and validate architecture and design decisions against delivery and operational requirements.
  • Require design changes or reject solutions that introduce unacceptable delivery risk; sign off on architecture only when designs meet agreed delivery, security and operability criteria.
  • Lead technical trade-off discussions, arbitrate between alternatives, and mandate pragmatic adjustments to preserve delivery timelines and quality.
  • Ensure solutions built using AI/ML components meet the requirements and align with platform and governance standards.

4.Business & technology translation

  • Translate business priorities into implementable delivery plans with clear acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.
  • Eliminate ambiguity in requirements and ensure engineering teams understand expected business behavior and success measures.
  • Balance business expectations with engineering realities; make clear recommendations on scope/timeline/quality tradeoffs.
